forbidden_claims.claim: Do not claim universal superiority, universal metabolic prediction, or uniform pathway reliability.
Do not describe transcript-derived scores, MRAS, or the quarantined output matrix as measured or absolute flux.
Do not use the quarantined nonzero METAFlux matrix for any affirmative biological association, ranking, validation, or pathway conclusion.
Do not claim positive spatial validation or direct barcode-level continuous-isotope association.
Do not generalize the human isotope or xenograft n=3 rank-preservation results to a population.
Do not identify one exact originating Human-GEM SBML/YAML release or claim a mass/charge-balance audit; that identity bridge was not proven.
Do not claim CPTAC metabolomics validation or direct barcode-level continuous MSI isotope data, because those endpoints were unavailable.

global_interpretation: Technical reproducibility, gene-level reliability transport, pathway-level RNA-protein concordance, context transportability, spatial association, and numerical optimization validity are distinct properties and must be evaluated separately.

permitted_claims.claim: The reference implementation enforces patient-level or equal-patient inference and rejects duplicate patient-metric rows that would create pseudoreplication.
In three human in-vivo tracing cases, the frozen primary acquisition score preserved the observed ordering descriptively (rho=1; exact p=1/3).
Across seven neurosphere models, isotope alignment was mixed and nonsignificant under the frozen exact joint test (p=0.1988095238095238).

Frozen DepMap-derived reliability weights transported at gene level in 71 genes (rho=0.6032900004412324), while pathway-level RNA-protein concordance was strongly pathway-dependent and weighting did not yield universal gain.
Matched lactate and glutamate orderings transported descriptively across three models (rho=1; exact p=1/3), with a severe n=3 ceiling.
The frozen patient-blocked spatial endpoint was null and opposite the expected direction (effect=-0.1552628978138; spatial-null p=0.2979702029797; exact sign-flip p=0.5).

All 42 sample-specific optimization problems met the prespecified tolerance-based zero-solution classification (zero feasible; solver-reported maximum biomass <=1e-10); this is not an exact-optimum proof. All 42 saved nonzero METAFlux vectors were primally infeasible at 1e-8.
The neurometbench-ref 1.0.1 source, wheel, public regression suite, claim firewall, and patient-aware statistical core reproduce from source-excluded installations.

scope: Patient-aware claim-admissibility auditing for transcript-derived metabolic inference in glioblastoma.
